title: Let the Bani cool what is burning
summary: This meets the overheated heart that has had enough of its own inner weather. The line says the Lord's Bani is not decoration but nectar.
takeaway: Return to the Bani for cooling.
lifeApplication: When the mind feels scorched, stop feeding it with more noise. Read or hear one line again before asking the day for another remedy.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord's Bani cools the heart like nectar taken in again.
source.lifeApplication: When the inside is burning, take the line in again before reaching elsewhere.

evidence.coreClaim: The Lord's Bani cools the heart like nectar taken in again.
evidence.turn: Read the Bani again until the inner heat cools.
